title: Reserve Second-Price Truth-Telling Is Dominant
body_html:
Reserve Second-Price Truth-Telling Is Dominant

For every reserve price, truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy in the reserve second-price auction ([[mechanism_design.auction.basic.reserve_second_price_mechanism]]).

Formally, for valuation profile \(v : I \to U\), bidder \(i\), and bid profile \(b\), replacing bidder \(i\)'s bid by \(v_i\) weakly increases bidder \(i\)'s utility: \[ u_i(v,b) \le u_i(v,b[i \mapsto v_i]). \]

Lean form

  • utility_nonneg proves that truthful bidding gives nonnegative payoff.
  • valuation_is_dominant proves the direct utility inequality.
  • truthful_weakly_dominant packages the same result as IsWeaklyDominant in the induced strategic game.
  • mechanism_isDSIC lifts the theorem to the MechanismWithTransfers.isDSIC predicate.
proof_html:
idea

The proof is the Vickrey dominance argument with one extra threshold. Bidder i's own bid does not change the highest bid among opponents, so the critical price faced by i is the maximum of the reserve and the highest opposing bid. Truthful bidding wins exactly when \(v_i\) clears that threshold; in the winning case the payoff is nonnegative, and in the losing case the payoff is zero.

References

  • [AGT, Chapter 9, Section 9.3] Nisan, Roughgarden, Tardos, and Vazirani, Algorithmic Game Theory.
  • [Krishna, Chapter 2] Vijay Krishna, Auction Theory, 2nd ed..
  • [Vickrey 1961] William Vickrey, "Counterspeculation, Auctions, and Competitive Sealed Tenders", Journal of Finance 16(1):8-37.

lean_refs.name: Auction.ReserveSecondPrice.utility_nonneg
lean_refs.signature:
lemma utility_nonneg {b : I → U} {i : I} (htruth : b i = v i) :
    0 ≤ utility reserve v b i

lean_refs.name: Auction.ReserveSecondPrice.valuation_is_dominant
lean_refs.signature:
theorem valuation_is_dominant (reserve : U) (v : I → U) (i : I) (b : I → U) :
    utility reserve v b i ≤ utility reserve v (Function.update b i (v i)) i
lean_refs.docstring: Truthful bidding dominates any other bid in the reserve second-price auction.

lean_refs.name: Auction.ReserveSecondPrice.truthful_weakly_dominant
lean_refs.signature:
theorem truthful_weakly_dominant (reserve : U) (v : I → U) (i : I) :
    IsWeaklyDominant (game reserve v) i (v i)
lean_refs.docstring: Truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy in the reserve second-price auction.

lean_refs.name: Auction.ReserveSecondPrice.game_eq_toStrategicGame
lean_refs.signature:
lemma game_eq_toStrategicGame (reserve : U) (v : I → U) :
    game reserve v =
      (mechanism reserve).toStrategicGame
        (fun (w : Option I) (pay : I → U) (vals : I → U) (i : I) =>
          if w = some i then vals i - pay i else 0)
        v
lean_refs.docstring: `game reserve v` equals the strategic game induced by `mechanism reserve`.

lean_refs.name: Auction.ReserveSecondPrice.mechanism_isDSIC
lean_refs.signature:
theorem mechanism_isDSIC (reserve : U) :
    (mechanism reserve).isDSIC
      (fun (w : Option I) (pay : I → U) (vals : I → U) (i : I) =>
        if w = some i then vals i - pay i else 0)
lean_refs.docstring: The reserve second-price auction satisfies dominant-strategy incentive compatibility.
